subject: Q3 objective tallies + narrative for exec readout (weights & retro)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft: Q3 tallies + proposed narrative and weights

Team —

Attached is the first pass of the Q3 tallies and an accompanying narrative for the exec readout. I applied the weighting rubric we discussed in the July leadership sync (revenue/customer health 40%, reliability/latency 30%, platform velocity 20%, strategic bets 10%). The spreadsheet has a per-OKR raw score, weighted score, and a short justification column per working group.

What I need from you:
- Quick sanity check on the weights and the three outlier scores in the Reliability section (rows 12–14).
- One-sentence edits to the narrative paragraph for your org (inline in the doc).
- Confirmation of owner(s) for the retro action items so I can include names in the final readout.

Attachments: Q3_OKR_raw_scores.xlsx (xlsx) — includes per-exec justification tabs and raw numbers.

Timing: please send comments by EOD Friday (2026-08-06). I plan to circulate the final readout for sign-off the following Monday and push the PDF to the exec packet.

Thanks —
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Strategy & Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Q3 tallies + proposed narrative and weights

Neha —

Thanks for the draft and the clear rubric. Quick notes inline and a couple of proposed changes:

- Reliability weighting feels high at 30% for the platform maturity stage we're in. Proposal: move 5% from Reliability -> Platform velocity. That better reflects the growth bets we've been resourcing.
- On row 13 (KV cache miss rate), the raw score looks understated; we've had two incidents but the remediation shipped late in the quarter — recommend changing justification to call out staged fixes and not full remediation.
- Suggest a short blurb for the exec narrative that calls out the predictable improvements in latency percentiles as a cost-efficiency win (helps when we defend infra spend).

If we shift the 5% as suggested, that produces a small upward movement in the overall platform score for Engineering. I can make the edit to the spreadsheet and re-upload if we agree.

-Markus
VP, Serving Runtime

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Q3 tallies + proposed narrative and weights

Markus + Neha —

Agree with Markus' tilt on the weighting; we should be explicit about our rationale in the narrative (i.e., why we prioritize velocity for the coming quarter). Markus — go ahead and update the spreadsheet and put a short note in the justification column that flags the change (so audit trail is obvious).

Two operational asks before we finalize:
1) Please capture the change as a versioned item in Redwood Console (settings -> OKR weights) so CS and Finance see the final weights when they reconcile compensation/bonuses.
2) Monica — can your CS team validate that the customer health metrics used here match the renewal-dashboard definitions? We want to avoid mismatched denominators.

On the KV cache entry Markus flagged: I think the score should remain conservative until the next release is in production for two weeks. Let's call that an action with owner and a 2026-08-20 target.

Neha — as you build the final PDF for the exec packet, please include a 2-line risk paragraph for each major score change (why it moved, mitigation, owner). That will make approval faster.

Vivek
Chief Product Officer

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: FINAL: Q3 tallies, narrative, and retro actions (v3)

Thanks all — final attached (v3). Changes since the first pass:
- We moved 5% from Reliability -> Platform velocity per Markus + Vivek (see "weight_change_log" tab in the spreadsheet).
- Adjusted the KV cache justification to reflect staged fixes; score remains conservative until 2 weeks post-release (owner: Markus; due: 2026-08-20).
- Monica confirmed customer health definition alignment via Slack (reference in Drive comment).
- Added 2-line risk statements for the five largest delta items to the executive narrative.

Final tallies (summary):
- Company composite: 78.6 (weighted)
- Product & Eng composite: 81.2
- CS & GTM composite: 76.9

Retro action items (owners & due dates):
- KV cache follow-through: Markus Klein — 2026-08-20 (verify in prod + update score)
- Customer health denominator reconciliation: Monica Patel — 2026-08-13 (confirm dashboard mapping)
- OKR weight versioning + console note: Neha Kapoor — 2026-08-10 (publish and notify Finance/Comp)
- Travel & spend variance deep-dive (Q3 impact): Laura Bennett — 2026-08-18

I've exported the attached PDF for the exec packet and uploaded both the spreadsheet and the PDF to Drive. Please reply with an explicit "LGTM" or a single-line objection by EOD Tuesday 2026-08-10. If I don't hear objections I'll push to the board packet on Wednesday.

Attachments: Q3_OKR_final_scores_and_narrative_v3.pdf (pdf)

Thanks —
Neha
Head of Strategy & Operations
Redwood Inference
